30 orders were captured twice, worth ₹3,36,391.42 across both captures.
Each order has two payment IDs. Typically the customer's first attempt appeared to fail at the browser so they retried, and both succeeded. Finding them is a lookup; deciding which capture is the real sale is the work.
Suggested action: decide which capture is the real sale, refund the other, and confirm the settlement batch still balances afterwards.
